AccurateGroup.description: Advanced condition group. Do not pass this field if advanced conditions are not enabled or the list is empty. If enabled, Logic and at least one valid AccurateRules must be provided.

AccurateGroupPriority.description: Priority of advanced condition group. Not required for create/update; used only for list display.

Id.description: Advanced condition group ID. Not required for create/update operations; used only for list display.

HttpObj.description: Match object. Fixed objects automatically generate HttpObj by ObjType. Custom objects require specifying the Key in HttpObj, e.g., request.header.clientip, request.uri, request.queryargs.abc, request.header.custom-header, request.cookie.custom-cookie, etc.

ObjType.description: Enumeration of match object types. 0: request protocol; 1: request URI; 2: request method; 3: request path; 4: request parameters; 5: request header; 6: User-Agent; 7: Referer; 8: Cookie; 9: request body length; 10: request body format; 11: X-Forwarded-For; 12: client IP; 13: custom Args; 14: custom Header; 15: custom Cookie; 23: JA3 Hash; 25: Session-ID; 26: client fingerprint.

Opretar.description: Enumeration of match operators. 0~5: size comparison; 6~11: substring match; 12~15: set match; 16: regex; 17~21: IP identification (only for request.header.clientip or custom objects); 23/24: include/exclude address group; 25/26: include/exclude geographic location; 27: include IP intelligence; 28/29: AS number belongs/does not belong.

Property.description: Match attribute type enumeration. 0: Value; 1: StrLen; 2: Size; 3: Keys; 4: Version; 5: IP (used only for Operator=17~21); 6: Country.

ValueString.description: Match value. IP identification operations with Operator=17~21 do not involve match content and can be an empty string. For Operator=23~29, fill in according to the corresponding format (IP address group ID/region code/IP intelligence tag/ASN). For other operators, enter the actual match value.

Crontab.description: crontab expression. Recommended format: * <startHour>-<endHour> * * <weekList>, for example * 18-20 * * 1,2,3,4,5.

PathThreshold.description: Total path threshold during the specified period. Value range: 1~300000.

SingleThreshold.description: Threshold for a single object during the specified period. Value range: 1~300000.

description: WAF Bot statistical protection rule. Applies to Bot frequency limit (StatisticalType=1) and Bot repeat statistics (StatisticalType=2/3) scenarios. Restricts requests based on objects such as request IP, Session, Header, etc.

AccurateGroup.description: Advanced condition group. Do not include this field if not enabled or if the list is empty.

ActionAfterVerification.description: Follow-up actions after challenge verification succeeds. Applies only when ActionType is 6 (JS challenge), 7 (human verification), or 10 (proof of work). 1: Block; 2: Monitor.

ActionType.description: Action to execute. 0: Observe; 1: Rate limit (supported only in frequency limit scenario, i.e., StatisticalType=1); 2: Block; 6: JS challenge; 7: CAPTCHA; 10: Proof of work; 11: Drop.

CronConfs.description: Periodic cycle configuration list. Supported only for frequency limit rules with StatisticalType=1. Threshold switching is specified by crontab.

EffectTime.description: Action effective duration in seconds, range 30~86400. Required when creating or updating rules except for ActionType=1 (rate limiting).

ExemptionTime.description: Exemption time for human verification, JS challenge, or proof of work, in seconds. Range 30~3600. Applies only when ActionType is 6/7/10.

Field.description: Statistical object. Supports single or multiple fields, separated by commas. Maximum of 10 fields. Basic format is DataType:Value, for example HEADER:X-Forwarded-For, CLIENTIP, COOKIE:token, ARGS:device_id, JA3HASH.

Host.description: Domain name. The website domain to be protected. Make sure the domain has been added to the current WAF instance before calling.

Name.description: Rule name. Must start with Chinese/letter/number. Allows Chinese/letters/numbers/period (.)/underscore (_)/hyphen (-). Length 1~128 characters.

PassRatio.description: JS challenge or CAPTCHA pass rate. Returned only when ActionType is 6/7/10.

Path.description: Request path to which the rule applies. You can specify an exact page path, match the entire site, or all paths under a directory (using wildcard *). The wildcard * can only appear at the end of the path.

PathThreshold.description: Overall threshold for the current path. Effective only when StatisticalType=1. Range 1~300000.

ProjectName.description: Project name, which is the project associated with the current resource. Only projects with permissions under the current identity can be associated.

RulePriority.description: Rule priority under the same path and advanced condition. Range 0~9, with 0 being the highest priority.

RuleTag.description: Rule display ID. Frequency limit rule prefix is R (e.g., R000000018673); repeated statistics rule prefix is S (e.g., S000000018674).

SingleProportion.description: Ratio threshold for a single statistical object. Enabled only when StatisticalType=3 (repeat ratio). Value range: [0, 1).

SingleThreshold.description: Threshold for the number of times per statistical object. Used only when StatisticalType=1. Range 1~300000.

StatisticalDuration.description: Statistical time window, in seconds. Frequency limit scenario (StatisticalType=1): 5~1800; repeat statistics scenario (StatisticalType=2/3): 1~60.

StatisticalType.description: Statistical method. "1": access frequency; "2": repeat count; "3": repeat ratio.

UpdateTime.description: Last update time of the rule.
